announcement.quote: Golub Capital Investment Corporation Announces Merger Agreement With Golub Capital BDC, Inc.

deals.notes: GBDC is shown as NASDAQ-listed (NASDAQ: GBDC) in the 2019-09-04 press release; no excerpt shows GCIC shares trading on an exchange, so both_listed is null.
